instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched Archicad graphical user interface. Do not open Terminal, Command Prompt, or PowerShell; do not run Python, shell, IfcOpenShell, Archicad API, scripts, macros, or any helper automation that directly generates or edits the deliverable file. Use only Archicad native GUI tools, menus, dialogs, palettes, element settings, and built-in save/export commands. Two-Room Consultation Suite. Start from a blank Archicad project with no init files or reference images. Build or edit the model using real Archicad BIM elements such as Walls, Slabs, Zones, Doors, Windows, Roofs, and Stairs where required; do not use visual-only Morphs, objects, meshes, or generic proxy placeholders as substitutes for required BIM elements. Save the only required deliverable on the Desktop as C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc using Archicad's built-in IFC export or Save As IFC workflow. Export the complete model as IFC4 and include the Zones/Spaces in the export. Model a simple single-storey suite about 8 m by 4 m divided into two rooms: WAITING and CONSULT. Use real walls including one internal partition, one floor slab, at least two doors, and at least two windows. The exported IFC should contain Zones exported as IfcSpace entries named WAITING, CONSULT. It should contain at least 1 building storey, at least 2 IfcSpace zones, at least 5 wall-like IfcWall or IfcWallStandardCase elements, at least 1 IfcSlab element, at least 2 IfcDoor elements, at least 2 IfcWindow elements. The shaped model should have an overall size roughly matching X span 8 m, Y span 4 m, and Z span 3 m. The IFC should have unique GlobalId values for IfcRoot objects and should not contain IfcBuildingElementProxy objects as substitutes for the required spaces, walls, slabs, roofs, stairs, doors, or windows. Other exact coordinates, room proportions, wall thicknesses, opening positions, materials, library part names, property sets, layers, relationship nesting, and harmless exporter metadata may vary as long as the saved result.ifc satisfies the stated BIM content.
